text:
anya: heads-up deploy-bot triggered on embeddings after merge to release/v2.8.0. canary p95 doubled. holding promotion.
deploy-bot: SAFETY_HOLD: embeddings.p95 > 2x baseline. Suggested actions: investigate, pin, or auto-rollback.
sam: do we let it auto-rollback or operator pin hosted only? we have reserved pools for two enterprise customers.
ben: avoid touching reserved pools automatically. manual operator pin for hosted endpoints only, keep tiny canary for telemetry.
anya: agree. ops, please pin hosted embeddings traffic back to v2.7.4 and suppress auto-rollback. keep 1% canary on v2.8.0. reason: "post-merge p95 spike"
ops-runner: running: `routerctl pin --route embeddings --target-tag v2.7.4 --canary 1 --reason "post-merge p95 spike"`
ops-runner: pin applied. hosted embeddings: 99%->v2.7.4, 1% canary on v2.8.0. auto-rollback suppressed.
ml-ops: i see kv_cache.evictions spiking around merge time; possible kv-format or cache priming regression. opening INF-2055.
ops-runner: warming up v2.7.4 nodes and running smoke: auth ok, embeddings-create latency back to baseline (~230ms), batch embeddings throughput nominal.
sam: good. what's our rollback trigger if this doesn't hold?
anya: propose criteria: embeddings.p95 > 500ms for 10m OR error_rate > 0.5% for 5m -> targeted rollback for embeddings-only to v2.7.3. also if dedicated-customer error_rate > 0.2% for 3m escalate to oncall and consider manual rollback for affected pools.
ben: approve. ops prepare rollback playbook but don't execute until criteria met.
kate: drafting customer advisory: "temporary routing pin to previous version for embeddings due to latency increase; monitoring closely." legal-bot please review.
legal-bot: review ok. avoid SLA language; recommended update cadence: 30m.
ml-ops: i'll coordinate with runtime team on INF-2055 and add a KV-compat regression test to post-merge CI.
ops-runner: follow-up smoke after pin: embeddings p95 215ms, quality sample 99/100. stability observed for 12 minutes.
sam: i'll prepare the brief public post and release-note blurb in case we widen impact.
anya: keep suppression for 1 hour and monitor. if stable after 45m unpin and attempt a staged re-roll with the KV fix (10% -> 50% -> 100%) with auto-rollback enabled for hosted-only. ops, coordinate canary ramp and run `deploy-bot revert-suppression` only when we start the staged reroll.
ops-runner: noted. standing by to run rollback command if criteria hit: `rollback --to-tag v2.7.3 --select embeddings` and will post back here when executed.
ml-ops: INF-2055 created and assigned. will post PR link in this thread when ready.
kate: customer advisory queued for send if stable for 15m. (:mailbox_with_mail:)
anya: closing loop for now: manual pin applied, auto-rollback suppressed, smoke validated, INF-2055 filed. reopen if metrics change. thanks all. :thumbsup:
